rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the assignment and write a narrow, administrable rule that a filing adding new habeas claims while direct appellate review of the first federal habeas judgment is pending is not “second or successive,” while reserving harder post-mandate/reopening scenarios. A Barrett-led dissent is the most probable separate writing, emphasizing the statute’s lack of an appellate-pendency carveout and reading Gonzalez/Banister to treat post-judgment claim-advancing filings as successive.
